description: The panel of a Tabs row (DESIGN.md, Tabs): shown only while its own tab is selected — otherwise nothing builds, so a hidden panel's child does no work either.

constructors.description: A panel for value, named label (the same text as its TabItem.label), shown while selected equals it.

params.name: value
params.description: The tab this panel belongs to.

params.name: selected
params.description: The selected tab's value, as given to the paired Tabs.

params.name: label
params.description: The panel's accessible name (its tab's label).
